text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 429s and p99 latency for Hosted API in ap-southeast-1. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. 429 rate 12% over 4m, p99 latency 2.8s. Paging @anna-oncall

anna-oncall: ack. oncall taking. pulling up autoscaler and gateway logs.

anna-oncall: quick snapshot: gateway returning 429 due to upstream throttles from internal request-limiter. I see a recent change to autoscaler config (min_replicas=2 -> 0) in the deploy at 1806120600. @dave-infra did that config change roll out to ap-southeast?

keiko-ml: we shipped a perf tuning that reduced idle pool, probably caused min_replicas=0 for opportunistic nodes. rollout completed across regions at 1806120625. cc @dave-infra

anna-oncall: logs from gateway:
```
[1806120661] req id 7b9c: upstream reject 429 -> reason "no healthy upstream"
[1806120663] autoscaler: scale_to 0 (idle) for pool inference-ap-se-1
[1806120665] throttle_count +1
```

anna-oncall: mitigation plan:
- pin min_replicas=2 for ap-southeast (applied)
- temporarily increase request-limiter quota per-customer by 30% (applied)
- spin up 3 warm nodes in ap-southeast (requested infra)
- post a short status update

dave-infra: provisioning 3 x t4g.large warm nodes for ap-southeast. ETA ~4m. also reverting autoscaler change from the deploy to restore min_replicas=2.

ria-cs: drafting status page blurb. Suggested wording:
```
We are investigating increased rate limit responses and higher latency in ap-southeast-1 affecting inference endpoints. Engineers identified an autoscaler configuration change that reduced warm capacity. We have reverted the change and are bringing additional capacity online. Customers may see 429s and slow responses for up to 20 minutes.
```

anna-oncall: please add a note advising customers pinned to specific nodes or edge-only deployment to temporarily switch region or remove strict pinning. Also include contact for paid customers to open an expedited support ticket.

ria-cs: added and queued update to status.redwood.ai.

deploy-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1806123456

anna-oncall: infra update: nodes coming up, healthchecks passing on 2/3 nodes. 429 rate down to 5% and p99 to 1.1s.

keiko-ml: root cause hypothesis: perf tuning reduced warm pool triggers when CPU usage below threshold. Under bursty traffic, autoscaler scaled to zero before gateway drained connections -> upstream errors -> gateway returned 429. Also noticed a mem-leak signature in one edge process that amplified throttling.

anna-oncall: mitigation completed: autoscaler revert + 3 warm nodes + temporary relaxation of per-customer quotas. Observed steady state: 429 < 1%, p99 ~420ms.

ria-cs: short customer email draft (paid customers):
```
Subject: Incident: Elevated rate-limits and latency (ap-southeast-1)

Hi — we experienced increased 429 rate-limited responses and latency in ap-southeast-1 due to an autoscaler configuration that reduced warm capacity. We reverted the config and provisioned extra capacity; service is now stable. If you rely on pinned nodes or edge-only deployments, please consider switching region temporarily. We will share a complete incident summary within 24 hours.

— Redwood Inference Support
```

anna-oncall: small addition — if customers use client-side retry, recommend exponential backoff with jitter and max attempts=4.

ria-cs: added. Sending to affected paid customers now. Email IDs: 92001,92002.

customer-support-bot: Auto-reply from MegaRetail: "Thanks for the quick fix. We saw a spike in customer-facing errors. Please include us on the RCA."

anna-oncall: handoff note — my shift ends in 40m. @keiko-ml will take primary, @dave-infra secondary for next 12h. Handoff summary:
- Hypothesis: autoscaler/perf-tuning interplay caused warm pool depletion -> gateway 429s.
- Actions taken: revert autoscaler change, spun up warm nodes, relaxed quotas.
- Next steps: patch autoscaler logic to never scale below configured min warm nodes; add pre-deploy check for autoscaler delta; investigate edge process mem leak.

keiko-ml: ack taking handoff. I'll run a canary of perf-tuning with strict min_replicas and monitor for mem usage.

anna-oncall: timeline (minimal):
- 1806120600: perf-tuning deploy rolled out
- 1806120640: first 429s reported by gateway metrics
- 1806120660: incident-bot alerted
- 1806120675: autoscaler revert applied
- 1806120695: nodes provisioned request sent (infra)
- 1806120730: warm nodes healthy, traffic draining restored
- 1806120800: error rate <1%, p99 improved

keiko-ml: action items & owners:
- eng-runtime: add autoscaler delta predeploy gate (owner: @dave-infra, ETA: 3 days)
- eng-ml: canary perf-tuning with min_replicas enforced (owner: @keiko-ml, ETA: 2 days)
- eng-sre: investigate and fix edge process mem leak (owner: @anna-oncall, ETA: 1 week)
- cs: send customer RCA (owner: @ria-cs, ETA: 12 hours)

dave-infra: filing infra ticket for predeploy gate and autoscaler rule update.

ria-cs: sent customer emails; receiving replies for two impacted customers. Preparing full post-incident RCA doc and will attach internal timeline and metrics.

customer-support-bot: Reply from MegaRetail: "Please include the exact window of impact and list of affected endpoints. We need this for our ops team."

ria-cs: noted — will attach timeline and endpoint list in RCA.

keiko-ml: monitoring looks stable. I'll keep the canary off until we implement min_replicas guard in CI.

anna-oncall: creating postmortem stub in eng-postmortems and linking status page. Please add logs, gateway traces, autoscaler events, and provisioning timestamps.

deploy-bot: Postmortem created: https://eng.redwood.ai/postmortems/1806123456

keiko-ml: handoff complete. oncall transferred to @keiko-ml (primary) and @dave-infra (secondary). Escalate to @anna-oncall if recurs.

anna-oncall: signing off. :white_check_mark:

---

(internal PM checklist snippet):
- include gateway traces and rate-limiter logs
- attach autoscaler config diff and deploy tag
- include email copies to customers and any replies
- postmortem author: @anna-oncall
